Step 3. The comparison, and the base it rests on
The five sources with a multi-year series. Reading the upper panel without the lower one invites a trend claim that the
number of records compared may not support; DAC = Doctors and Clinicians, formerly Physician Compare; PECOS = Provider
Enrollment, Chain, and Ownership System; CCN = CMS Certification Number.
